messages:
mike yang: hey team — PR #33721 is blocked by a flaky CI failure on integ-shard-6, seen on two runs in a row. Can someone with approval rights kick a targeted rerun or give guidance? :wave:

alex p: saw this in the logs earlier, looks like `grpc-integ` hung waiting for a connection. quick log excerpt:
```
[2026-03-15T18:02:14Z] ERROR: test_grpc_reconnect_timeout - timeout waiting for server (300s)
stack: test/integration/grpc_reconnect_test.py:42
last output: "Waiting for server at 10.0.5.23:50051..."
```

priya r: thanks for pinging. I don't have owner perms this hour — can someone from platform or infra approve a rerun pls? If it fails again we should consider a targeted bisect.

ci-bot: Rerun requested by mike yang. Queue position: 3. Use `/ci rerun pr 33721 --shard=6 --targeted` to trigger a targeted job.

kevin: @priya r I can approve if you want me to. One ask: add the `--capture-network` flag to the rerun so we get tcp dumps if it flakes again.

mike yang: thanks kevin — doing that now. running:
```
/ci rerun pr 33721 --shard=6 --targeted --capture-network
```

jen: fwiw, infra saw increased pod restarts last night in that region. might be unrelated but worth checking cluster events for the rerun window. :eyes:

alex p: if rerun passes we should still add a short ticket to make the test less timing-sensitive (increase retry/backoff) — it's brittle under noisy CI.

priya r: agreed. if rerun fails again I can carve out time to bisect next sprint. for now, kevin — please approve when you confirm the rerun triggered.

kevin: approved and watching. ping me if it flakes twice, I'll start a bisect. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: Targeted rerun started (job id: 81472). Logs will stream to buildkite: https://builds.redwood.ai/81472

mike yang: copied. linking this thread to the PR for visibility. I'll open a small follow-up to increase timeouts if we see nondet behavior.

jen: noted — I pulled cluster events for the last 24h and attached to the rerun job. will update if anything suspicious shows up.

alex p: quick reminder — if you need a merge window change after rerun, ping #eng-sre to avoid slot contention.

mike yang: got it, thanks all. will update here once rerun finishes.
